newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Compaq to create 550 jobs in Dublin.
newsitem.headline: Compaq to create 550 jobs in Dublin.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corporation said on Tuesday it is to locate a major pan-European Customer Care Centre in Dublin and create more than 550 new jobs within three years.
The company said in a statement that the centre would provide a streamlined level of service through the latest telecommunications technology across European markets.
Ireland's Enterprise Minister Richard Bruton welcomed the announced and said he looked forward to a speedy start-up.
He said the centre expected to handle up to 4.5 million calls per year and would operate 24 hours a day, seven days week.
Teleservices is one of the fastest growing businesses in Ireland with some 3,500 jobs created in the sector over the last four years.
Ireland's state development agency, the IDA, expects the sector has the potential to reach a target of 5,000 jobs by the end of the decade.
